styleIcon: Hand-painted storybook game icon for a cosy early-medieval settlement strategy game. Warm earthy palette (golden thatch, timber brown, moss green, bilberry blue, cream). A single object, centred, filling about 80% of the frame, isolated on a fully transparent background. No text, no letters, no frame, no ground shadow, no background scene.

assets.prompt: Three freshly cut timber logs stacked in a small pyramid, pale cut ends with visible tree rings, brown bark.
Two roughly squared grey stone blocks, one resting on the other, with chisel marks and a few chips.
A small cluster of ripe bilberries (deep blue-purple) with two green leaves on a short sprig.
A neat stack of three sawn wooden planks, light honey-coloured wood grain, tied with a twine strap.
Two simple friendly villager figures side by side, an adult and a child, wearing rustic tunics and little pointed hoods, faces kept very simple.
A woodcutter's axe embedded in a chopping stump, with a couple of wood chips.
A woven wicker basket overflowing with bilberries.
An iron pickaxe leaning against a rough grey boulder.
A young green sapling growing from a small mound of dark soil, with a little wooden trowel beside it.
A small round thatched roundhouse with wattle walls, a dark doorway and a wisp of chimney smoke.
A two-handled pit saw resting across a log on wooden trestles.
A small timber storehouse barn on stone footings with a thatched roof and big wooden doors.
A rolled parchment scroll, partly open, tied with a red ribbon.
A wooden mallet crossed with a small iron hammer.

Game logo wordmark that reads exactly "FirstFolk" in one line. Chunky hand-carved wooden lettering with warm golden-honey highlights and a dark brown outline, slightly playful storybook serif letterforms. A small thatched roundhouse sits on top of the letter F, a sprig of green leaves curls from the final k, and a few bilberries decorate the base. Centred, isolated on a fully transparent background, no other text.

A family with a covered wooden wagon pulled by an ox arrives at dawn at the edge of a lush green river valley, distant low hills, pine and oak woods, morning mist over a winding river, a few birds in a peach and pale-blue sky. Wide landscape composition with space at the bottom centre.
Seamless tileable texture of soft cream parchment paper with very subtle fibres and faint warm mottling, evenly lit, flat, no stains near edges, no text.
Two fresh silvery-blue river fish (trout) lying crossed, with pink speckles, glistening scales and a sprig of green reed.
A small reed-thatched fisher's hut on short stilts at a riverbank, a wooden drying rack with three fish hanging, and a coiled net.

A sturdy square watchtower: a dressed-stone lower storey, a whitewashed timber-framed upper storey with a railed walkway, a steep dark thatched pyramid roof and a long blue banner flying from the top.

A long Anglo-Saxon timber longhouse seen from a three-quarter angle: dark vertical plank walls, a huge golden thatched roof sweeping almost to the ground, carved crossed gable ends and a small wooden door with a coloured family banner beside it.
A scouts' camp: a small canvas tent beside a crackling campfire ringed with stones, and a tall pole flying a red pennant.
A small ring of great grey standing stones with flat lintel stones laid across their tops, on a mossy green mound, a golden glow at the centre.
A grand carved timber mead hall with a long steep dark thatched roof, carved dragon-head gable ends, and a foaming wooden mead tankard in front.
A great timber granary raised on mushroom-shaped staddle stones, with a big golden thatched roof, two cream grain sacks and a basket of bilberries in front.
A golden laurel wreath around a shining five-pointed gold star.
A small round palisade fort: a ring of sharpened timber stakes around a little thatched guardhouse, an open gate at the front, a red round shield and two crossed spears by the gate.
A round wooden Saxon shield painted in red and cream quarters with an iron boss in the centre, a spear leaning behind it.
A tall wooden lookout watchtower on a low stone base: four timber legs with cross-bracing, a ladder, a railed platform with a small pointed thatch roof, and a red pennant flying from the top.
